SELECT
  LEFT(p.product_id, 10) AS product_id,
  COALESCE(p.product_category_name, 'unknown') AS product_name,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price))::NUMERIC(20,2) AS total_revenue,
  COUNT(oi.order_item_id)::INT AS total_quantity_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY LEFT(p.product_id, 10), COALESCE(p.product_category_name, 'unknown')
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
